title: Index JSON for Chimera Viral Alignment Databases

database_descriptions.viral_refseq: An index of viral RefSeq assemblies, originally used in the mSCAPE viral alignment database.

0.1.0.description: Initial release of the viral alignment database index.
0.1.0.methods_summary: Database constructed from NCBI RefSeq viral genomes (on date 2025-09-29). Sequence taxa were matched to the NCBI taxonomy (version 2023-10-01). Database was constructed with 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CLIMB-TRE/zeus/refs/heads/main/database_creator.py'

0.2.0.description: Second release of viral alignment database index with minor updates. Specifically improved fuzzy matching algorithm for organism names.
0.2.0.methods_summary: Database constructed from NCBI RefSeq viral genomes (on date 2025-09-29). Sequence taxa were matched to the NCBI taxonomy (version 2023-10-01). Database was constructed with 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CLIMB-TRE/zeus/refs/heads/main/database_creator.py'

0.3.0.description: Third release of viral RefSeq database index with updated taxonomy, improved matching logic, also, added new segment metadata field for segmented viruses.
0.3.0.methods_summary: Database constructed from NCBI RefSeq viral genomes (on date 2026-04-13). Sequence taxa were matched to the NCBI taxonomy (version 2026-06-01).

0.4.0.description: Fourth release of viral RefSeq database index with updated taxonomy, further improved matching logic.
0.4.0.methods_summary: Database constructed from NCBI RefSeq viral genomes (on date 2026-08-10). Sequence taxa were matched to the NCBI taxonomy (version 2026-03-01).
